actions: Locate oak trees in the current area.
Equip your hand to break blocks.
Approach the nearest oak tree.
Break the first oak log block using your hand.
Collect the dropped oak log.
Repeat steps 3 to 5 until you have broken and collected a total of 7 oak log blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 oak logs.
Locate a crafting table in your current area or open your personal crafting interface.
Open the crafting menu.
Place the 7 oak logs in the crafting grid.
Ensure that the oak logs are arranged in any pattern in the crafting grid.
Collect the 12 oak planks that appear in the result box.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 12 oak planks.
Open your inventory to check the number of wooden planks you have.
Ensure you have at least 4 wooden planks in your inventory.
If you do not have 4 wooden planks, locate a crafting station or your inventory crafting grid.
Place 4 wooden planks in the crafting grid by selecting them from your inventory.
Arrange the 4 wooden planks in a square formation in the crafting grid.
Collect the crafting_table that appears as a result of the crafting process.
Verify that your inventory now contains 1 crafting_table.
Locate a crafting table in your vicinity.
Open the crafting table interface by right-clicking on it.
Place 2 wooden sticks in the crafting grid.
Ensure you have at least 1 wooden stick in your inventory for crafting.
Verify that the crafting grid shows the recipe for sticks.
Collect the 2 crafted sticks into your inventory.
Repeat the crafting process by placing 2 wooden sticks in the crafting grid again.
Collect the next 2 crafted sticks into your inventory.
Continue this process until you have crafted a total of 3 sets of 2 sticks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 6 sticks.
If you need additional sticks, repeat the crafting process once more.
Collect the final 3 sticks into your inventory.
Now verify that your inventory contains a total of 9 sticks.
Locate a crafting table in your current area.
Approach the crafting table.
Open the crafting table interface.
Place 3 wooden planks in the top row of the crafting grid.
Place 2 wooden planks in the middle column of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the center square of the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting recipe for a wooden pickaxe is correctly displayed in the result box.
Drag the wooden pickaxe from the result box into your inventory.
Close the crafting table interface.
Check your inventory to confirm that you now have 1 wooden pickaxe.
Open your inventory and ensure you have a pickaxe equipped.
Locate a stone surface or a cave in your current area where cobblestone can be found.
Approach the stone surface or cave until you are close enough to interact with the blocks.
Break the first stone block using your pickaxe.
Collect the dropped cobblestone until it is picked up into your inventory.
Repeat the process of breaking stone blocks with your pickaxe.
Continue breaking stone blocks until you have collected a total of 11 cobblestone.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 11 cobblestone.
Locate a crafting table in your current area.
Approach the crafting table.
Open the crafting interface by right-clicking on the crafting table.
Place 3 cobblestone blocks in the bottom row of the 3x3 crafting grid.
Place 2 sticks in the middle column of the crafting grid, one in the center square and one in the bottom square.
Verify that the crafting grid shows 1 stone_pickaxe as the output.
Drag the stone_pickaxe from the crafting table output slot into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface.
Confirm that your inventory now contains 1 stone_pickaxe.
Locate a mountain or a cave where coal is typically found.
Approach the location where you see exposed stone or coal ore blocks.
Equip your pickaxe from your inventory.
Break 3 coal ore blocks using your pickaxe.
Collect all the dropped coal items until you have 3 in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 3 coal.
Locate a crafting table in your vicinity or place one down if you have it in your inventory.
Open the crafting interface by right-clicking on the crafting table.
Identify the crafting grid with 3 rows and 3 columns.
Place 8 cobblestone blocks in the crafting grid, filling all slots except the center.
Ensure that the center slot remains empty, while the outer slots are occupied by cobblestone blocks.
Verify that the crafting grid shows a furnace icon as a result of your arrangement.
Take the furnace from the result box in the crafting interface.
Close the crafting interface after successfully obtaining the furnace.
Confirm that the furnace is now in your inventory.
Locate a cave or mountainous area where iron ore is commonly found.
Equip your stone pickaxe from your inventory.
Mine iron ore blocks until you have collected 7 iron ore in your inventory.
Ensure that you have not lost any iron ore during the mining process.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 iron ore.
Open your inventory to verify you have at least 3 pieces of iron ore.
Locate a furnace within your vicinity or place your own if you have one in your inventory.
Right-click on the furnace to open its interface.
Place the 3 iron ore in the top slot of the furnace.
Gather at least 3 pieces of coal or charcoal from your inventory.
Place the coal or charcoal in the bottom slot of the furnace.
Wait for the furnace to smelt the iron ore into iron ingots.
Once the iron ore has finished smelting, collect the 3 iron ingots from the furnace.
Repeat steps 2 to 8 two more times to smelt a total of 9 iron ore into iron ingots.
After completing the smelting process three times, you should have 9 iron ingots in your inventory.
Open your inventory and confirm that you have at least 7 iron ingots.
Open your inventory to check the current contents.
Ensure you have at least 3 iron ingots in your inventory.
Ensure you have at least 2 sticks in your inventory.
Navigate to a crafting table in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Place 3 iron ingots in the top row of the 3x3 crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the center square of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the middle square of the bottom row of the crafting grid.
Verify that the iron pickaxe appears as a craftable item.
Drag the iron pickaxe into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Open your inventory to check that you have at least 3 iron ingots and 1 bucket of water (if you're crafting a bucket).
Locate a crafting table in your current area or create one using 4 wooden planks.
Approach the crafting table.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Place 3 iron ingots in the crafting grid in a "V" shape (one in the bottom-middle slot, and one in each of the middle-left and middle-right slots).
Ensure that the crafting interface shows a bucket as the result.
Drag the bucket from the crafting result slot into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 1 bucket.
Open your inventory and ensure you have at least an iron pickaxe available for mining diamonds.
Locate the nearest cave entrance or dig downwards to reach a depth of Y-level 11 or lower, which is optimal for finding diamond ore.
Equip your iron pickaxe by selecting it from your inventory.
Enter the cave or continue digging until you reach the appropriate depth.
Start exploring the cave or your tunnel, looking for exposed diamond ore blocks.
Mine any visible diamond ore blocks using your iron pickaxe.
Collect all dropped diamond ore until you have mined 29 diamond ore blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 29 diamonds.
If you have not yet mined 29 diamonds, continue searching for more diamond ore in the cave or by digging in nearby tunnels.
Repeat the mining process until you reach the goal of 29 diamonds.
Locate a gravel block in the current area.
Break 1 gravel block using a shovel or your hand.
Collect the dropped gravel until you have at least 1 gravel in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains at least 1 gravel.
Place the gravel block on the ground.
Break the gravel block again using your shovel or hand.
Check for any drops from the broken gravel block.
Verify that you have obtained at least 1 flint in your inventory.
Locate a crafting table in your vicinity.
Open the crafting table interface.
Place 3 wooden planks in the top row of the crafting grid.
Place 2 wooden planks in the left and right slots of the middle row of the crafting grid.
Leave the bottom row of the crafting grid empty.
Verify that the crafting grid shows a water bucket recipe completed.
Drag the water bucket from the crafting table output to your inventory.
Confirm that your inventory now contains 1 water bucket.
Locate a crafting table in your vicinity or place one down if you have the materials.
Open the crafting table interface to access the crafting grid.
Ensure that you have at least 3 diamonds in your inventory.
Verify that you have at least 2 sticks in your inventory.
Place 3 diamonds in the top row of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the center square of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the bottom center square of the crafting grid.
Check that the diamond pickaxe appears in the result box of the crafting grid.
Drag the diamond pickaxe from the result box into your inventory.
Confirm that the diamond pickaxe is now present in your inventory.
Locate a crafting table in your vicinity.
Open your inventory and ensure you have at least 1 iron ingot and 1 flint.
Select the iron ingot in your inventory.
Drag the iron ingot to the crafting table interface.
Select the flint in your inventory.
Drag the flint to the crafting table interface.
Arrange the iron ingot in the center slot of the crafting grid.
Place the flint in the bottom slot of the crafting grid.
Place another flint in the top slot of the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting table shows a flint_and_steel in the result box.
Click on the flint_and_steel to collect it into your inventory.
Check your inventory to confirm that you now have 1 flint_and_steel.
Ensure you have a diamond pickaxe in your inventory.
Locate a lava pool in the current area; it can typically be found underground or in caves.
Gather 10 water buckets in your inventory.
Use the water buckets to place water near the lava pool.
Observe the interaction of water with lava, and ensure that it creates obsidian blocks.
Stand next to the newly formed obsidian blocks.
Begin breaking the obsidian blocks using your diamond pickaxe.
Continue to break the obsidian blocks until you have collected 10 obsidian in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 10 obsidian.
If you have less than 10 obsidian, repeat steps 4 to 9 until you reach the required amount.
Open your inventory to ensure you have at least 4 diamonds and 2 leather.
Locate a crafting table in your area or place one if you have it in your inventory.
Approach the crafting table.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 2 diamonds in the left column (one on top of the other).
Place 2 diamonds in the right column (one on top of the other).
Place 1 leather in the center square of the crafting grid.
Ensure that the crafting grid shows diamond_boots as the resulting item.
Drag the diamond_boots from the crafting grid into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface to complete the task.
Locate a crafting table in your current vicinity or place one down if you have it in your inventory.
Open the crafting table interface to access the crafting grid.
Ensure you have at least 24 diamonds in your inventory, as this is the required amount to craft diamond_leggings.
Drag and drop 24 diamonds into the crafting grid.
Place 2 diamonds in the left column of the crafting grid, one in the center square, and 2 diamonds in the right column of the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting recipe is correct by checking the shape of the diamonds in the grid.
Once the diamond_leggings appear in the result box, click on them to collect them into your inventory.
Close the crafting table interface to complete the process.
Check your inventory to confirm that you now have 1 diamond_leggings.
Open your inventory and ensure you have at least 24 diamonds.
Locate a crafting table in your current area or place one down if you have it in your inventory.
Approach the crafting table and right-click to open the crafting interface.
Arrange the 24 diamonds in the crafting grid to form a diamond chestplate.
Ensure that the crafting grid shows the diamond chestplate as a result.
Move the diamond chestplate from the crafting result slot into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 diamond chestplate.
Open your inventory to check if you have at least 24 diamonds.
Verify that you have a crafting table in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in a convenient location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Arrange 8 diamonds in the crafting grid by placing 3 diamonds in the top row, 2 diamonds in the middle row, and 3 diamonds in the bottom row.
Drag the diamond helmet from the crafting table into your inventory.
Confirm that the diamond helmet is now present in your inventory.
Open your inventory to check that you have at least 2 diamonds and 1 stick.
Ensure you are in a crafting area or have access to a crafting table.
Approach the crafting table with your inventory open.
Place the 2 diamonds in the crafting grid, one in the first slot and one in the second slot of the first column.
Place the stick in the crafting grid, in the center slot of the second column.
Confirm that the diamond sword is displayed in the result box of the crafting grid.
Drag the diamond sword from the result box into your inventory.
Close the crafting table interface to complete the process.
Ensure you have at least 10 obsidian blocks in your inventory.
Find a flat area where you want to build the nether portal.
Use the first obsidian block and place it on the ground as the bottom left corner of the portal frame.
Place the second obsidian block directly to the right of the first block.
Place the third obsidian block directly above the first block.
Place the fourth obsidian block directly above the second block.
Use the fifth obsidian block and place it at the top right corner of the portal frame.
Place the sixth obsidian block directly to the left of the fifth block.
Use the seventh obsidian block to complete the left side of the portal frame by placing it directly below the sixth block.
Place the eighth obsidian block directly below the fifth block to complete the right side of the frame.
Ensure the frame is in a rectangular shape, consisting of 4 blocks tall and 5 blocks wide.
Use flint and steel from your inventory to ignite the inside of the portal frame.
Observe the purple portal surface forming inside the frame.
Verify that the nether portal is active and ready to use.
Open your inventory and ensure you have at least 1 blaze powder.
Locate a nether fortress in the Nether dimension.
Enter the Nether fortress by passing through a Nether portal.
Navigate through the fortress until you find a blaze spawner.
Equip a weapon suitable for combat, such as a sword.
Stand near the blaze spawner and wait for blazes to spawn.
Attack the blazes as they appear, ensuring you avoid their fireballs.
Continue attacking until you defeat at least one blaze.
Collect the blaze rod dropped by the defeated blaze.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 1 blaze rod.
Locate a Nether Fortress in the Nether dimension.
Identify a Blaze spawner within the Nether Fortress.
Approach the Blaze spawner carefully to avoid being attacked.
Use a melee weapon, such as a sword, to defeat at least one Blaze.
Ensure that the Blaze has dropped Blaze Rods upon defeat.
Collect the dropped Blaze Rods until you have at least 1 in your inventory.
Open your inventory to verify that you have at least 1 Blaze Rod.
Access a crafting table or your personal crafting grid.
Place the Blaze Rod in the crafting grid.
Craft 1 Blaze Powder from the Blaze Rod.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 Blaze Powder.
Find a nether fortress location in the Nether dimension.
Approach the fortress carefully to avoid enemy mobs.
Locate and kill at least 4 blazes in the fortress using a sword.
Collect the blaze rods dropped from the blazes.
Verify that you have at least 4 blaze rods in your inventory.
Return to the Overworld by using the Nether portal.
Find an enderman spawn location, such as a desert or a plains biome.
Wait until nightfall or ensure it is nighttime.
Look for endermen in the area.
Attack one enderman with your sword.
Defeat the enderman while avoiding its attacks.
Collect the ender pearl dropped by the defeated enderman.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 ender pearl.
Locate a Nether fortress in the Nether dimension.
Enter the Nether fortress through its entrance.
Identify a blaze spawner within the fortress.
Approach the blaze spawner carefully.
Equip your sword from your inventory.
Attack the blazes that spawn from the spawner.
Collect blaze rods from the defeated blazes.
Ensure you have at least 1 blaze rod in your inventory after defeating the blazes.
Return to your portal and exit the Nether back to the Overworld.
Locate a crafting table in your vicinity or place one down if you have it in your inventory.
Open the crafting interface.
Combine 1 blaze rod and 1 ender pearl in the crafting grid.
Retrieve the resulting ender eye from the crafting output.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 ender_eye.
